subject: ophthalmology
title: Intraocular tumours

steps.tx: **Retinoblastoma** (RB1 suppressor, 1 in 18,000 births) whitens the pupil (**leukocoria**) with strabismus in toddlers; sporadic unilateral versus heritable bilateral multifocal with pineal trilateral risk. Calcification on imaging with endophytic (vitreous seeds) or exophytic (subretinal seeds, detachment) growth confirms; International Classification (A to E) stages salvageability. Systemic and intra-arterial chemotherapy shrink for focal laser or cryo, enucleation for advanced unilateral with optic nerve margin histology, and radiotherapy debates balance second tumours. Family screening with EUAs rescues siblings.
steps.say: White pupil in toddler is retinoblastoma until scanned: calcified mass. Bilateral means heritable: screen family.

steps.tx: **Uveal melanoma** (commonest adult primary intraocular malignancy) mushrooms through Bruch membrane (collar button) in choroid with lipofuscin, low reflective B scan hollowness and sentinel vessels; iris lesions tan with corectopia while ciliary body tumours hide with pressure rise. Prognosis follows size, epithelioid cells and chromosome 3 loss with liver metastasis surveillance; plaque brachytherapy saves medium eyes, proton beam selected, enucleation for large or nerve invasion. Transillumination and biopsy debates stage while systemic therapy lags.
steps.say: Mushroom mass with orange pigment in adult is melanoma: collar button through Bruch. Liver watches after.

steps.tx: **Choroidal metastases** (breast, lung primaries) cream multiply with exudative detachment in known cancer patients, treated by systemic therapy with palliative retinal laser; **haemangioma** (Sturge Weber port wine with tomato ketchup choroid) leaks needing photodynamic therapy; **osteoma** (young women, calcified yellow) observes; **primary vitreoretinal lymphoma** (elderly with CNS signs) biopsies for methotrexate pathways. Retinal capillary haemangioblastoma (von Hippel Lindau with feeder vessels) lasers or cryos early with systemic screening.
steps.say: Creamy multiple choroidal lumps in cancer patient: metastases. Port wine face plus red choroid: Sturge Weber.

steps.tx: **Key point.** Genetics and lifelong follow up: RB1 counselling with prenatal testing and sibling EUAs, second osteosarcoma risk after radiotherapy, pineal MRI in heritable disease; melanoma gene expression profiling with liver imaging schedules; von Hippel Lindau systemic surveillance (cerebellum, kidneys, phaeochromocytoma). Prosthetic rehabilitation with orbital implants follows enucleation; phthisical painful blind eyes need comfort pathways. Masquerade inflammations (lymphoma, uveitis) biopsy before steroids commit.
steps.say: Tumour genes need family screening for life. Second cancers haunt irradiated retinoblastoma survivors.
